options.rationale: Preserves the core W06 one-shot per-cell scientific measurement contract: every cell makes at most 1 outbound HTTP generation request, keeping call count, cost envelope, and failure attribution strictly deterministic.

Marked NOT_RECOMMENDED_WITHOUT_MAJOR_METHODOLOGY_CHANGE. Allowing even 1 transport retry on HTTP 503/504/timeout breaks the 1-call-per-cell invariant, doubles worst-case call and cost exposure, and confounds single-shot reliability with retry recovery.

candidate_timeout_options.comparability_implications: Exact match to primary benchmark, but severely confounds planner itinerary quality with the 55s transport cutoff for 3-day and 4-day structured JSON generation.
candidate_timeout_options.engineering_rationale: Caps per-cell wait time at 55s, bounding worst-case 180-cell sequential wall-clock time to 2.75 hours.
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_still_censoring_long_responses: DEMONSTRATED_HIGH: In frozen primary evidence, 52/60 C2 cells timed out at 55,078..55,797 ms, All 8 completed C2 cells were 2-day scenarios (35,812..53,094 ms; max 53.09s is within 1.91s of the 55s cutoff), and 0/20 3-day and 0/20 4-day C2 scenarios completed within 55s. C1 also recorded 14/60 TIMEOUT cells (4 client ReadTimeout at 55,781..56,016 ms and 10 server 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED at 53,031..55,891 ms).
candidate_timeout_options.scientific_rationale: Represents the preregistered primary operational timeout boundary (55,000 ms). Preserved as the immutable reference for the primary 180-cell benchmark.

candidate_timeout_options.comparability_implications: Uniformly relaxes the client-side deadline across C1, C2, and C3, but risks leaving substantial client-side right-censoring on 3-day and 4-day scenarios.
candidate_timeout_options.engineering_rationale: Moderate increase in per-cell deadline while keeping worst-case 180-cell sequential execution under 4.5 hours.
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_excessively_long_stuck_requests: LOW_TO_MODERATE (90s max stall per stuck socket).
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_still_censoring_long_responses: MODERATE_TO_HIGH: Because C2 2-day completions already reached 53,094 ms (median 45,898.5 ms), 3-day and 4-day itineraries with 3 interests and medium/adaptive reasoning may plausibly exceed 90,000 ms without completing structured JSON output.
candidate_timeout_options.scientific_rationale: Provides a +63.6% (+35,000 ms) client-side deadline expansion above the frozen 55s cutoff where 52/60 C2 cells and 13/14 C1 timeout cells clustered; permits calls to continue up to 90s on the client side without predicting any completion count or success rate.

candidate_timeout_options.comparability_implications: Applied identically to C1, C2, and C3 under the secondary stabilization track while preserving primary 55s results intact.
candidate_timeout_options.engineering_rationale: Standard 2-minute synchronous API timeout ceiling compatible with Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic SDK defaults, bounding worst-case 180-cell sequential wall-clock time to 6.0 hours.
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_excessively_long_stuck_requests: MODERATE (up to 2 minutes per stalled transport call if a provider hangs).
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_still_censoring_long_responses: MODERATE_LOW: Substantially reduces right-censoring relative to 55s and 90s, though complex 4-day scenarios under C3 high/adaptive thinking or C2 medium reasoning could still approach 120s under provider load.
candidate_timeout_options.scientific_rationale: More than doubles (+118.2%, +65,000 ms) the frozen 55s client-side cutoff, extending the client deadline beyond the observed 2-day completion range (35.8..53.1s) and reducing client-side right-censoring risk on 3-day and 4-day scenarios; no completion count or success rate is predicted.

candidate_timeout_options.comparability_implications: Removes the frozen 55s client-side cutoff from the secondary configuration and materially reduces client-side right-censoring risk across C1, C2, and C3 on equal terms; provider-side deadlines, capacity errors, quota failures, or other transport failures may still prevent observation.
candidate_timeout_options.engineering_rationale: Aligns client-side httpx timeout with longer upstream gateway deadlines for large structured JSON generation (max_output_tokens=16,384); note that upstream provider server-side 504 deadlines (such as Google 54..55s gateway timeouts) may still occur independently if enforced by the provider's server infrastructure.
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_excessively_long_stuck_requests: MODERATE_HIGH (up to 3 minutes per genuinely hung connection; worst-case 180-cell all-timeout run is 9.0 hours, though healthy completions terminate upon response receipt).
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_still_censoring_long_responses: LOW_CLIENT_SIDE (Note: client-side censoring above 180s is unlikely for normal generation, though provider-enforced server-side HTTP 504 deadlines remain controlled by the provider).
candidate_timeout_options.scientific_rationale: Provides 3.27x (+125,000 ms) the frozen 55s client-side cutoff, materially reducing client-side right-censoring risk across 2-day, 3-day, and 4-day itinerary schemas for all three reasoning configurations (C1 thinking_level=medium, C2 reasoning_effort=medium, C3 effort=high + thinking=adaptive); no completion count or success rate is predicted.

candidate_timeout_options.comparability_implications: Identical across candidates, but operationally heavy with limited incremental benefit over 180s.
candidate_timeout_options.engineering_rationale: 4-minute client socket ceiling; exceeds typical cloud load-balancer idle timeouts and increases worst-case sequential batch duration to 12.0 hours if many cells stall.
candidate_timeout_options.risk_of_excessively_long_stuck_requests: HIGH (up to 4 minutes per hung request; diminishing return over 180s because upstream provider gateways frequently enforce their own server-side deadline at or before 60..180s).
candidate_timeout_options.scientific_rationale: Included as a fourth reference option only if ChatGPT prioritizes near-zero client-side timeout censoring for C3 high/adaptive thinking + 16,384 max_output_tokens on 4-day catalogs (~93 KB wire payload).

counterfactual_firewall.permitted_evidence_statement: 55 seconds demonstrably censors many C2 requests at the configured boundary (52/60 C2 cells timed out at 55,078..55,797 ms, and 8/8 C2 completions were 2-day scenarios at 35,812..53,094 ms).
